items: Admission that 'We should have flagged that dependency to you sooner' (not in input)
Promise to 'confirm by Monday whether 13 Nov holds' (no such commitment in input)
Claim that 'Until we do, we can't work on the Pune setup' (input says only that VPN access is still missing, not that work is blocked)
Requested deadline 'by Monday 9 Nov' for VPN access (date not in input)
'last week': the input gives no date or timing for the PyCon India talk
Freelancer 'Option A: renew at half scope, saving 12.0 lakh per quarter': the input gives no half-scope option or 12.0 lakh saving
Freelancer 'Option B: renew as-is' and the recommendation of Option A: these options and the recommendation are not in the input
'scope list from team leads by Nov 20': this date and commitment are not in the input
Slide 6 total of 30.7 lakh (88% of target) and the 4.2 lakh gap: the arithmetic is correct, but both rely on the invented 12.0 lakh freelancer saving
'AWS reserved instances (ready to approve)': the input says nothing about readiness for approval
'pull the line items from the Datadog invoice this week': this action and timeline are not in the input
'remaining 4.2 lakh gap comes back with sized numbers next week': this promise and timeline are not in the input
'GCP and Zendesk usage review' as a way to close the gap: not mentioned in the input
Claims to have verified the charges ('I can see two Pro plan charges'); the input only has the customer's report
Claims a completed action: 'I've raised a refund'
Picks PRO-55121 as the duplicate to refund; the input doesn't say which one is the duplicate
Promises the Pro plan 'stays active under PRO-55120'
Promises an email when the refund is processed
States the refund will go back to the original payment method
Promises to follow up if the refund doesn't arrive
"so nobody is signed out by the switch": the input only says old Redis keys are read as a fallback for 7 days. It does not promise that no user will be logged out by the migration.
A '3-year bar' (minimum experience requirement) for the role; the input gives no experience threshold
A '6-year range' (maximum experience) for the role; the input gives no such range

States as fact that Candidate A has worked on idempotency, matching ledger entries against bank files, and handling late or duplicate settlements; the input only says they built a UPI reconciliation service
Claims Candidate A has experience with query planning, retention, and migrations on hot tables; the input only mentions Postgres partitioning
Characterizes Candidate B's HR portal as low-throughput CRUD with no high-scale data work; the input only says they maintained an internal HR portal
Claims Candidate C's Razorpay webhook work involved retries, signature checks, and out-of-order events; the input only says they wrote payment webhook handlers
Unconditionally promises Saturday delivery ('Haan bilkul, Saturday ke liye ho jayega'). The input only gives the 24h-before order rule, not confirmed availability for Saturday.
Implies a name/message-on-cake service ('Cake pe koi naam ya message likhna hai?'), which the input does not mention.
